project.name: lending-library
project.description: The Lending Library: a small Java library lending app using Jersey, Hibernate and Grizzly.

nodes.name: export-csv.md
nodes.summary: Documents the semicolon-separated CSV format returned by GET /loans, which spreadsheet users depend on.

nodes.name: reports-spec.md
nodes.summary: Specification of a monthly lending report from a retired reporting module; only this spec remains, no code.

nodes.name: pom.xml
nodes.summary: Maven build for the lending-library app (Java 17): Jersey/Grizzly, Hibernate, H2 dependencies and dependency copying at package time.

nodes.name: run.sh
nodes.summary: Shell script that builds with Maven and launches lib.App.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses set -euo pipefail and exec to replace the shell with the JVM.

nodes.name: AboutPage.java
nodes.summary: JAX-RS resource serving GET /about by returning the static about.html from the classpath.

nodes.name: App.java
nodes.summary: Application entry point: creates the JPA EntityManagerFactory, wires resources into a Jersey ResourceConfig and starts a Grizzly HTTP server on PORT.

nodes.name: FinePayments.java
nodes.summary: JAX-RS resource for POST /payments/{id} that charges a loan's late fee via an external payment gateway (PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL).

nodes.name: pay
nodes.summary: Checks the loan exists, then POSTs to the payment gateway and maps its response to 200 or 502.

nodes.name: LateFeeView.java
nodes.summary: JAX-RS resource for GET /fees/{id} rendering an HTML page with the late fee (25 cents/day, capped at $10, waived up to 2 days late).

nodes.name: page
nodes.summary: Computes days late and the fee in cents, then returns an HTML fragment or 404.

nodes.name: Loan.java
nodes.summary: JPA entity for the LOAN table; a book lent to a member, due 14 days after lending.

nodes.name: Loan
nodes.summary: Entity with id, member, isbn, lentOn and returnedOn; provides dueOn() and markReturned().

nodes.name: LoanRepository.java
nodes.summary: Repository over JPA providing all/find/lend/markReturned with helper read/write transaction wrappers.

nodes.name: LoanRepository
nodes.summary: Data-access class managing EntityManager lifecycle and transactions for Loan entities.

nodes.name: LoanResource.java
nodes.summary: JAX-RS resource for /loans: list, get, lend and return endpoints, emitting semicolon-separated text lines.

nodes.name: LoanResource
nodes.summary: REST resource class exposing loan operations and formatting loans via line().

nodes.name: persistence.xml
nodes.summary: JPA persistence unit 'library': registers Loan, uses in-memory H2, drop-and-create schema, and loads seed.sql.

nodes.name: LOAN
nodes.summary: LOAN table populated with three sample loans at startup.

nodes.name: about.html
nodes.summary: Static About page with opening hours, 14-day lending period and contact details.

nodes.name: LOAN
nodes.summary: Table LOAN mapped by JPA entity Loan
